description: This file defines utility functions for resolving and creating writable rename targets, primarily used for file operations such as renaming within a sandbox environment. It includes functions to resolve rename targets with a given context and ensures write permissions are handled appropriately.

methods.name: export function resolveWritableRenameTargets<T extends { containerPath: string }>(params: { resolveWritableRenameTargets
methods.description: Resolves the 'from' and 'to' file targets for renaming, ensuring they are writable, based on provided parameters and resolver functions.

methods.name: export function resolveWritableRenameTargetsForBridge<T extends { containerPath: string }>( resolveWritableRenameTargetsForBridge
methods.description: A wrapper that simplifies calling 'resolveWritableRenameTargets' with a specific 'resolveTarget' and 'ensureWritable' functions.

methods.name: export function createWritableRenameTargetResolver<T extends { containerPath: string }>( createWritableRenameTargetResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver function for renaming targets, given a 'resolveTarget' and 'ensureWritable' functions.

ctags.name: from
ctags.pattern: /^  const from = params.resolveTarget({ filePath: params.from, cwd: params.cwd });$/

ctags.name: to
ctags.pattern: /^  const to = params.resolveTarget({ filePath: params.to, cwd: params.cwd });$/
